utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — I’ll be ready right around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, right after pickup works for me too — I’ll send the note and we can head out then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye — I’ll be ready right after pickup and keep my phone handy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m checking on the repair drive time and the remaining supplies now. The tools are in decent shape, and I’ll confirm whether the drill battery is charged once I take a look.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — please let me know the time and which supplies are still needed once you’ve checked the drill battery.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll check the drill battery and get back to you with the repair drive time and the remaining supplies soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. I’m a bit forgetful, so if you remind me later I’ll keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’ll send you a reminder with the Sunday time and the bring-list so we’re not scrambling.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Pia — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep an eye out for your reminder and stick with Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it’s on—please go ahead and tell people. I’ll keep you posted as folks reach out and say what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming—you’ll keep me posted if anyone reaches out with what they can bring, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted if anyone reaches out with what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — what time is the repair drive, and do we still need hands, tools, or any spare supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 10 a.m. on Saturday, and we could still use a few extra hands, plus screwdrivers and a couple spare light bulbs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll pass that along. Thanks, Ira.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — Sunday at the community center works, but can you send the timing soon so I can plan the ride and what to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still planning to bring my tools by the repair drive and help where they need it most. I’ll send the timing soon so you can plan your ride and bring-list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — once you send the timing and bring-list, I can sort out the ride and pack what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard you’re short on duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and a few spare screws, so I’ll keep an eye out for those and pass them along if I spot them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Glad to help — I’ll let you know if I hear of any of those turning up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll keep an eye out for Opal’s confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks Mara — I think that’s still the plan, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Noah — I’m all set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll watch for your update.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — thanks, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Bo — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, glad we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll keep spreading the word and point folks your way for the repair drive. I’ll let you know if I hear of anyone with tools or supplies to spare.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira—that means a lot. Keep me posted if anyone can spare tools or supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do—I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and send anyone your way who can help with tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, glad to help. I’ll swing by late and check in once things get rolling.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep everything ready for when you swing by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Rey — see you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Quinn. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks Rey — I’m glad it’s all set for Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — the biggest needs are still the priority, so let’s start there and match volunteers to each repair. And just a reminder, we’re now meeting Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll help match each repair to the right volunteers and keep us on track for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that’s perfect. I’ll keep the list organized and we can assign volunteers to the top repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m a bit late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. We just need to sort the donations and load the boxes into the van.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll help sort the donations and load the boxes into the van.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday around 9 at the community center and help get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh great, Sunday at the community center at 9 works perfectly—thanks for coming by. I’ll let folks know the new spot and time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to help, Tess — I’ll see you Sunday at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check what they need most first and then I’ll update you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for your update and then I can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check what they need most first, then I’ll update you so you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any update on the latest tally for Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact count, Mina, but the drive is set for Sunday at the community center now. I can check the latest tally and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. Please let me know the latest tally when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the quieter tasks on Sunday at 9 at the community center, and I’ll bring the screwdriver set and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Sunday at 9 at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll be there a little early and keep to the quieter jobs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Glad to help — I’ll keep an eye out for any more updates and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep telling folks it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll keep tracking for any more updates and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that on Sunday at the community center. Just point me to the most urgent repairs when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Rey — thank you. I’ll meet you at the community center Sunday and send you right to the most urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Rosa. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and ready to help with the most urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — 9:30 Saturday works after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll be there at 9:30 with the tools. Thanks for coordinating the repair drive, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Gus — see you then after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll look it over when you send it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, Leo — I’ll send over the updated details and sign-up list soon. Thanks again for helping keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll check it when it comes through.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s definitely still on, right? You’ll send the details soon?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — it’s still on, just moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so Sunday at the community center — got it. You’ll still send the details soon, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, quick update, Uli — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else change.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. Sunday at the community center works better for me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Glad to hear it, Uli — I’ll keep you posted if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an eye out for the update.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s now on Sunday at the community center — not Saturday at the front porch anymore.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — Sunday at the community center now. Thanks for the heads-up, Opal!
